description: A partial expression as an EVALUATE selection object (WHEN > 3, WHEN NOT NUMERIC, a bare class-name) - a COBOL-2002 addition, QUOTED from ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 48: "EVALUATE statement, partial expressions. A partial expression may now be used as a selection object in an EVALUATE statement." The COBOL-85 selection object (§1985:VI.6.13.2) is ANY, condition-1, TRUE, FALSE, or [NOT] identifier-3, literal-3 or arithmetic-expression-1 with an optional THROUGH operand. kb/Work PB398 added the alternative and PB5179 gated it. Gated in ONE place, VersionConformancePass.ParseArm.VisitEvaluateWhenItem, on the partialExpression alternative of evaluateWhenItem (VCR row 7.47).
display: a partial expression as an EVALUATE selection object
citation: ISO §2023:14.9.13.3 SR5; §1985:VI.6.13.2 (the selection objects); ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 48
vcr: VCR Table 7 row 7.47 - the 2002 Annex F.2 relaxations of COBOL-85 restrictions (item 48)

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMEVP.
